run_pix2struct_image_processing_tests: run the Pix2StructImageProcessingTest suite to verify image processor backends produce equivalent flattened_patches output
test_pix2struct_backend_equivalence: test that all Pix2Struct image processing backends produce equivalent flattened_patches for single and batched images
test_pix2struct_call_pil: test the Pix2Struct image processor with PIL image inputs across multiple max_patch sizes in batched and unbatched modes
test_pix2struct_call_vqa: test the Pix2Struct image processor in VQA mode requiring header_text and verifying correct output tensor shapes
test_pix2struct_compile_torchvision: test that the Pix2Struct torchvision backend can be compiled with torch.compile and produces equivalent output
